NextQuestionStreamEvent.description: The `data` of one `text/event-stream` event; the SSE `event:` field repeats `type`.
NextQuestionStreamEvent.title: NextQuestionStreamEvent

difficulty_distribution.description: Counts per difficulty for solved problems.

focusAreas.description: Specific skills or patterns to drill.
focusAreas.title: Focusareas

reasoning.description: Brief explanation of why these topics fit this user.
reasoning.title: Reasoning

recommendedTopics.description: 2-5 DSA or topic areas the user should prioritize next (e.g. binary search, graphs).
recommendedTopics.title: Recommendedtopics

notes.description: Short rationale for the section score.
notes.title: Notes

StreamDelta.description:
More of the question's text, in order. Concatenated, the deltas are a prefix of
the final `question`; the `done` event's copy is authoritative.
StreamDelta.title: StreamDelta

StreamError.description:
Generation failed after the stream opened. `status` is what the JSON endpoint
would have returned (429 rate limited, 503 otherwise).
StreamError.title: StreamError

followupFocus.description: The main concept to probe in a follow-up.
followupFocus.title: Followupfocus

shouldAskFollowup.description: Whether a follow-up question should be asked.
shouldAskFollowup.title: Shouldaskfollowup

focus.description: The weak area or concept being probed.
focus.title: Focus

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language hint, e.g. en.
language.title: Language

post.description:
`/next-question`, with the question's text streamed as it is generated (D-065).

Bad input, a retrieval outage, or a provider failing before its first token are
ordinary HTTP errors, exactly as on the JSON endpoint. After that the response is a
`text/event-stream` of `delta` events and one `done` (the JSON endpoint's body) or
`error`.

get.description:
Token, latency and estimated-cost totals for this process.

In-memory by design: a restart resets them, and a multi-instance deployment
would need a real metrics backend. Enough to answer "what does one interview
cost" without adding infrastructure.
